main_body: Dark green ground patch (gothic-themed grass/moss) tiled 4x3 with scattered small tufts and pixel dots; a flat terrain surface, not a standing object
top_band: none - flat ground texture, no standing volume
evidence: The candidate is a seamless ground texture patch, so the 3/4 top and front contract does not apply. It has no standing body, no side faces and no elevation drawing. As terrain it is acceptable for the 3/4 view check.

style.evidence: The base is one very dark green with only about 2-3 close tones, plus sparse red, yellow and brown accent dots. The tuft shapes repeat on a regular lattice, so the patch looks stamped. Large areas of near-uniform dark green carry no grain or variation. Beodeul grass and paving use 5-6 lightness steps, with clumps and per-stone shading. Tiles here hold roughly 4-6 colours, which is much lower than the reference. The patch is also so low in contrast that the material ramp barely reads.
